name: Vázsnok (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Vázsnok: a crowned white shield with a black bird, with blue and yellow mantling and a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Vázsnok arms with crown, mantling and scroll
